# mtion studio sub-actions

## Get active clubhouse

Finds out which clubhouse (project) is open in mtion studio and keeps its details for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%mtion.running%` | True if mtion studio answered |
| `%mtion.clubhouse.found%` | True if a clubhouse is open |
| `%mtion.clubhouse.name%` | The clubhouse's name |
| `%mtion.clubhouse.id%` | The clubhouse's id |
| `%mtion.clubhouse.description%` | The clubhouse's description |

<small>Type id: `mtion.getActiveClubhouse`</small>

## Get external triggers

Reads the list of external triggers in the open mtion clubhouse and keeps it for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%mtion.running%` | True if mtion studio answered |
| `%mtion.triggerCount%` | How many triggers there are |
| `%mtion.triggerNames%` | All trigger names, separated by commas |
| `%mtion.triggers%` | The full list with parameters, as raw text |

<small>Type id: `mtion.getTriggers`</small>

## Send trigger

Fires an external trigger in mtion studio, for example to make your avatar celebrate. The trigger must exist in the clubhouse that is open.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Trigger** | The external trigger's name (or id) from the open clubhouse, like "Confetti". |
| **Parameters** | Extra values the trigger takes, one per line as name=value, like "Amount=5". Use the parameter's name or its number (0, 1, ...). For a list-type value, give the option number, starting at 0. Leave empty for none. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%mtion.running%` | True if mtion studio answered |
| `%mtion.trigger.found%` | True if a trigger with that name exists in the open clubhouse |
| `%mtion.trigger.sent%` | True if mtion accepted the trigger |
| `%mtion.trigger.name%` | The trigger's name |
| `%mtion.trigger.id%` | The trigger's id |

<small>Type id: `mtion.sendTrigger`</small>
